subject: Re: Kickoff: dot-product vs learned similarity for the recs scorer
body:
Compute and staffing, confirmed today.

Staffing: Carmen and Freya split the reproduction sweeps (ml-1m and pinterest-20 respectively), Milan builds the internal-corpus data path, Wanjiru handles the serving-side ANN benchmark.

Compute: the public reproductions run fine on titan-a100 best-effort — the MF code is simple and single-GPU. The internal engagement-corpus sweep is the heavy piece. We have the vulcan-h100 reservation locked for the week of 2026-06-01: 384 accelerators, confirmed through Ines Uzun's reservation process. That covers the full embedding-dim sweep (16 to 192) with 8 repeats per config plus the learned-similarity comparison arm in one week.

Please don't let the memo date slip left — we can't get Vulcan earlier than June 1 and I don't want to burn the reservation on partial configs.

Daniela
